notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b003:l001: Unresolved сындабы in Улуктугум сындабы!: prior draft 'Has my dignity been broken?' treated it as broken, but primary Yudakhin сын and 1969 dictionary give сында жок as perfect/beyond criticism, including Улуктугуң сында жок. Printed form lacks жок and is not сынды; the complete rhetorical sense remains uncertain. https://el-sozduk.kg/сын/ Completion-first first pass: Low-confidence rendering for “Улуктугум сындабы!”; no close corpus parallel was found.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b003:l006: Primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/туна/ gives exact туубай туна чөгөйүн idiom: curse hour of birth/wish never born. Replaced preliminary literal sinking image; no actual self-harm event invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b003:l009: Before destined death explicit lament, not a statement the character now dies.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b003:l012: Ыйман modesty/shame here in facing elder, not an asserted conversion or loss of religious faith.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b003:l013: Кызырдуу favored by Khizr, spiritual patron, preserved; not a new human character.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b003:l014: Балпактап bold/heavy approach qualified in self-reproach, not a physical description added to Bakai.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b003:l020: Hair grown down back20/braided in front21 retained. Mourning propriety context; no universal cultural rule inferred.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b003:l027: Narrator says God heard her voice; preserve source religious perspective.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b003:l029: Көмкөрөдөн face down, not merely fainting with an invented diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b003:l035: Mother-in-law directly calls Kanykei shameless and challenges honorable status36–37; reversal from comforting speech retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b003:l038: Атан gelded pack camel, жети seven, дилде gold coin; not seven generations ата.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b004:l004: Garden/cuckoo comforts of Talas evoked in rhetorical contrast with flight; not a claim current wilderness is Talas.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b004:l008: Кең-Кол place-name Keng-Kol; багың garden here, good fortune24, pun preserved contextually.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b004:l012: Бел support/backbone/ridge pun; rendered support rather than literal lack of anatomical waist.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b004:l014: Right-indented кылба жөнү жок at15 belongs to same printed verse; both source IDs preserved, counted once.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b004:l017: Printed no night like Кадыр түн, contrasting86 positive hope; retained without harmonizing speaker’s rhetoric.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b004:l018: Drawing curtain, trembling and refusing visitors are explicit remembered court behavior, not invented modern diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b004:l024: Бак good fortune rather than garden in this line; surrounding garden pun noted8.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b004:l029: Boulder-like bulk qualifier could attach child30 rather than Chyiyrdy27; English kept directly before child without assigning bulk to elder.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b004:l035: Арбаңдатып causative child limbs moving, making laugh; not walking independently.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b004:l036: Coughing subject provisionally Chyiyrdy who carries child38–39; no medical explanation. Repetition retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0087:b004:l037: Күпү pillow stuffed with wool: Yudakhin sense3 and 2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/күпү/. Child bulk comparison, not barrel or battle armor; exact material not inserted into verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b003:l001: Entire left column then entire right column, individually visually checked from PDF image. Deterministic legacy-font-v1 with unchanged raw/SHA/bbox. Direct model translation, no prior English input.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b003:l002: Карааны child as surviving support/presence, not a separate dark apparition.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b003:l004: Hem touches ground explicitly; do not silently make it hem lifted for walking.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b003:l012: Баспайын negative inability/wish not to walk retained beside repeated struggle to continue; not changed to positive.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b003:l014: Burning/bursting heart figurative joy and grief, not actual death.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b003:l018: Twelve sinews/vessels and eighty joints epic body enumeration; numbers retained, not anatomical claims.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b003:l021: Ириңдеп discharging/purulent eyes explicitly, not merely tears; no medical diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b003:l023: Кирилдеп rattling chest qualified orthographic variant of common wheezing sound; audible strain not invented sickness.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b003:l029: Syr Darya bank named in source; geography not silently reconciled with Talas flight itinerary.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b003:l032: Өлгөндө жетти idiomatic arrived only with extreme difficulty, not literal death before arrival.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b003:l034: Бута бою qualified arrowshot distance ahead of Bakai, not an arrowshot-sized dog. Primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/бута/ arrowshot sense and Карасаев бута бою; attachment merits review. Ак тайган white hunting hound, not horse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b003:l036: Bakai follows hound while mounted on gray steed, not hunting Chyiyrdy.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l004: Bloody tears and collarbone overflow hyperbolic grief explicitly retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l006: Бириндеп scattered/divided thoughts, primary Yudakhin/1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/бирин/; not an unexplained proper name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l008: Бир = пир spiritual guide, twelve-guide allegiance formula applies Manas9, no numerical emendation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l009: Өлбөй кал counterfactual wish to deceased Manas, not resurrection event.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l014: Арыман from honor/shame; source differs from variant армандан sorrow, no silent substitution.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l015: Bakai refers to himself in third person15–17; retained rather than changing surviving child’s identity.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l020: Балтыр бешик cradle infancy; not literal calf anatomy in this compound.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l022: Керимсел caring/warm, Yudakhin gives exact керимсел абаң мен Бакай at https://el-sozduk.kg/керим/83–84, not dry hot wind.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l025: Талоо plunder/persecution, primary https://el-sozduk.kg/талоо/; distinct from blood-stream wording84.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l028: Beard tearing grief28, mustache33 repeated distinct body words preserved.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l029: Упаа faithful/beneficial, possessions fail to protect heir; no promise of money solving harm.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l031: Samarkand31 and Bukhara35 both printed; retain named destinations without harmonizing geography.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l032: Буткулдан interpreted all over/everywhere (бүткүл), qualified vowel form; not unverified place-name Butkul.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0088:b004:l039: Өлгөндө көргөн long-awaited after suffering, not literally obtained after speaker’s death; чырак lamp child metaphor.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l001: Албай койбой ne boldum double negative rhetorical regret: not refraining from receiving child as trust from Manas2; qualified object from preceding88:39 and later6, not a new acquisition event.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l004: Калбай койбой regretting remaining alive, preserved separately from receiving child1; elliptical negation merits review.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l006: Аманат entrusted surviving child/presence, not temporary burial here.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l008: Take me with you addressed to dead Manas, lament not narrative self-harm action.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l010: Kara-Shaar and Kambyl retained as printed names, no modern identifications imposed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l014: Repeated why did I not die then refrain14/17/23/38 and right7/15 kept; мында literally here contextual then at past occasions.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l015: Айчык golden crescent on standard, not lunar weather or invented religious symbol interpretation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l018: Каканчылуу ruled by khagan, source Beijing label retained; not present-day government claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l019: Six months khan/governor rule stated in narrator-character epic history; no external historical assertion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l024: Бил elephants, as confirmed earlier Manas lexical work https://el-sozduk.kg/бил/, next loaded with gold explicit; not thousand slaves or knowledge.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l026: Thimble mouth/camel-calf eyes and dark-eyed women taken as tribute28 are source objectification; preserved without endorsement or invented sexual acts.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l031: Суусар marten-fur cap, distinct кундуз otter at right28; cap swaying with wearer’s movement qualified.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l033: Attacking Chinese as crows metaphor retained as speaker’s hostile description.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l035: Таш сайынган official rank stones on caps, earlier documented source correction; not stone worship. Таза finest men36, not bald people.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b003:l039: Golden throne left39 continues right1 across column break but both are separately typeset verse lines, not indented wrap; do not merge.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b005:l003: Span-measuring backs3/slashing4 punishment explicitly retained, no extra method or injury details.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b005:l008: Бусурман Muslim here contrasted with капыр unbeliever10, not mistranslated as infidel due to Russian cognate.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b005:l012: House on ridge defensive stability metaphor; no literal building project added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b005:l013: Бейлеп governing, contextual khan rule; not same observe sense in earlier Manas62.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b005:l017: Needlessly parted from widow/orphan, bad reputation: character self-reproach, not newly narrated death.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b005:l022: Бурку kind/different, primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/бурку/ exact numbered бурку эл formula; seven thousand different peoples retained as epic hyperbole. Scratch placeholder resolved before freeze, no unresolved verse remains.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b005:l025: Receiving saint’s blessing then requested child26: no previous English version consulted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b005:l028: Күндуз/кундуз otter, not beaver: primary Yudakhin https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?lfrom=kg&word=кундуз; көрпө lambskin. Both collar-fur endearments retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b005:l029: Баргек valued head adornment/cherished support, primary earlier Yudakhin gun/head formulas; no invented jewel type.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b005:l031: Айнек mirror/glass endearment qualified mirror as surviving image of Manas; do not replace with ordinary child and omit metaphor.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b005:l033: Right-indented калган чырагым!34 joins33 as one verse, both physical fragments preserved. Туйгун prized goshawk title and көкжал fierce wolf both retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0089:b005:l037: Waking/dream alternatives37–38 repeated in opposite order, retained in full.
